name: Authored anatomical flesh body v5
method: New broad anatomical SDF forms and vertex paint around the original Meshy skeleton, with explicit swept horn meshes and recessed facial features. Original paw vertices define clean convex hull faces; the source rig and contact attributes remain byte exact. This is a locally authored derivative, not a new Meshy generation.

reproducibility.method: The tracked authoring script was run into two fresh output folders, then each was packed. Both packed GLBs and the integrated asset are byte identical.
reproducibility.scope: Verified on listed Windows/Python/Node/library versions; cross-platform byte identity is not asserted.

saddleRegression.method: Exact triangle/slab clipping of actual indexed posed visible skin. Original source faces are evaluated at the byte-exact retained original vertex prefix in the identical posed skeleton. Whole-mesh bounds and invisible-pool vertices are not collision evidence.

limitations: Real browser animation and independent art review are separate required checks.
New topology has authored normalized skin weights; original atlas UVs apply only to retained source vertices. New body appearance uses vertex colors.
The new mesh stores the original contact pool even where those original triangles are no longer drawn.
Some blended new surfaces reduce mixed influences to the largest four; the recorded discarded influence mass concerns new authored weights only. Original weights are unchanged.
SourceContactVertices metadata must remain available to contact inspection. The legacy smoothing for the old shredded mesh must be skipped for authoredFlesh assets.

previousGeneration.name: Authored anatomical flesh body v5 before saddle clearance correction

changesSincePrevious: Lower the rear dorsal arc and shorten its shoulder hump; narrow the ribcage and haunches, lower the deltoids and taper the proximal rear limbs. These coherent form edits clear the unchanged occupied saddle decks, without deck-shaped cutouts. Retain v5 facial planes, horns, v4 combat crest, original source contact pool, paw hulls, complete rig and body fitting.
